name: Sepia Blur
summary: Elements of this aesthetic are heavily tied to its roots in mimicking vintage photos of the late 1800s/early 1900s, which often had a heavy, dirty gradient quality due to its limited excess technology.
description: Elements of this aesthetic are heavily tied to its roots in mimicking vintage photos of the late 1800s/early 1900s, which often had a heavy, dirty gradient quality due to its limited excess technology. During the late 1980s, there was a steady rise of indie artists that included a lot of vintage low quality vibes in their music videos. This contrasted with the rise of grunge and then affected the rest of the 1990s. This ode to vintage styles can also be seen in the rise of aesthetics such as Global Village Coffeehouse and Frasurbane . Sepia Blur uses desaturated colors and grainy/worn out filters, especially in promotional materials and music videos.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): DIY ethos
